description: A village scene in West Africa (near Nigeria/Cameroon). Families are packing bundles. Children are helping. There is a sense of anticipation.
text_content: A long time ago, a great adventure began. Families in West Africa started to pack up their belongings. They were moving.

description: A wide shot of a large group of people walking through a lush forest path. Sunbeams filter through the trees. They carry baskets and tools.
text_content: Why did they move? Maybe their families were growing big. Maybe they were looking for new land. We call this the Bantu Migration.

description: Close up of a farmer planting yams with an iron hoe. The tool looks sturdy and effective compared to stone or wood.
text_content: These travelers had a secret weapon. It wasn’t a sword—it was knowledge. They knew how to make iron and grow yams.

description: People in dugout canoes navigating a wide, misty river (the Congo). The jungle is dense on both sides.
text_content: As they moved south and east, they cut through the thick rainforests. They built canoes to paddle down the mighty Congo River.

description: A meeting between a Bantu group (taller, with iron spears) and a Khoisan group (smaller, with bows). They are exchanging goods cautiously.
text_content: They met other people who lived in the forests, the Pygmies and the Khoisan. Sometimes they fought, but often they traded and shared ideas.

description: A conceptual image showing a 'tree' of languages branching out across a map of Africa. Words float in the air.
text_content: The Bantu people brought their language with them. Today, millions of people in Africa speak languages that are cousins to each other!

description: A vast herd of 'Ankole' cattle (long horns) grazing on the savanna. Herders watch over them. The sky is big and blue.
text_content: They also brought their cows. In the grassy plains of the south, their herds grew huge. Cattle became their bank account.

description: An aerial view of a traditional circular African village (kraal). Huts surround a central cattle pen. Smoke rises from cooking fires.
text_content: They built villages in circles, with the cattle in the middle to keep them safe. This was the 'kraal'.

description: Travelers reaching the coast of South Africa. They look out at the ocean, tired but triumphant.
text_content: It took thousands of years, but these families walked all the way to the bottom of the continent.

description: A happy scene of a village celebration. Drums are playing, people are dancing. Iron jewelry glints in the firelight.
text_content: They filled the land with farms, iron, and songs. They are the ancestors of many of us today.

description: A young child planting a seed in the ground. Behind him, a vision of many future cities and nations rises.
text_content: The Great Trek wasn't just a walk; it was the planting of a whole continent.

description: A parchment map of Sub-Saharan Africa. Large arrows sweep from Nigeria/Cameroon down into the Congo, East Africa, and South Africa.
text_content: Map: The Moving Families. This map shows arrows moving from West Africa down to the South and East. It looks like a flowing river of people.
